thread:
maria: quick FYI — hitting intermittent reassembly races in streaming toolcall flow when func params get chunked. client sometimes receives `toolcall.part` then a later `toolcall.complete` for a different call id. Repro in staging.

liam: can you paste the raw event sequence? is seq_no in the proto present or are we relying on timestamps?

maria: here’s an example (simplified):
```
{ type: "toolcall.part", call_id: "c-42", part_id: 1, total: 3, payload: "..." }
{ type: "toolcall.part", call_id: "c-43", part_id: 1, total: 2, payload: "..." }
{ type: "toolcall.complete", call_id: "c-42", part_id: 3, payload: "..." }
```
client reassembles by call_id but when connection hiccups events for c-43 arrive between parts for c-42 and we end up finalizing wrong call.

samir: hmm — I think this is because we don't have a monotonic stream sequence at the router level. We send `event_id` + `timestamp` but event_id is per-node and can overlap. I prototyped adding `stream_seq` (u64) in the delta envelope. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1023

olivia: for compat, we should tolerate missing `stream_seq`. Proposal: clients prefer `stream_seq` if present, otherwise fallback to `(connection_id, per-event-counter)` and continue to use `call_id` for reassembly. Also add `partial_id` on parts to avoid collisions.

maria: agreed — adding `partial_id` is low-effort. I'll add an e2e that simulates cross-connection interleaving.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `streaming-fix` branch to staging (build 2026.03.16-2210)

eva: I can own the e2e. Will add a flaky-run job and a deterministic ordering test. tagging @eng-runtime & @eng-platform reviewers.

liam: please include a small consumer-side defensive check: ignore `toolcall.complete` if you haven't seen any matching `toolcall.part` (with configurable window). That avoids premature finalization when seq missing.

maria: noted. plan: (1) add `stream_seq` optional to envelope, (2) add `partial_id` to toolcall parts, (3) runtime accepts both v1/v2, emits fallback ordering hints, (4) add client defensive check + e2e. I'll open PR and @-mention reviewers. 

samir: 👍 once PR is up I'll review runtime changes. Also logging trace_id for replay will help debug.

olivia: +1. pls add a short note in the convo API docs about ordering guarantees and compat behavior.

maria: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
